Fragile X spectrum disorder (FXSD) includes: fragile X syndrome (FXS), fragile 
X-associated tremor ataxia syndrome (FXTAS) and fragile X-associated primary 
ovarian insufficiency (FXPOI), as well as other medical, psychiatric and 
neurobehavioral problems associated with the premutation and gray zone alleles. 
FXS is the most common monogenetic cause of autism (ASD) and intellectual 
disability (ID). The understanding of the neurobiology of FXS has led to many 
targeted treatment trials in FXS. The first wave of phase II clinical trials in
